title: Bike & Brew: Beautiful Denver Downtown Tour by E-Bike or Bicycle
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Children must be accompanied by an adult
Operates in all weather conditions, please dress appropriately
No infant seats or carriers available
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Join a knowledgeable local tour guide who will guide you safely through downtown Denver's most important and relevant tourist sights including historic buildings, architectural masterpieces, professional sports stadiums, scores of public art installations, parks and outdoor venues.  Tours go out daily.  Groups are small, 2-16 people with a tour guide to guest ratio of 1:9.  Duration of tour is 3 hours and approximately 9 miles.  TOWARDS THE END OF THE TOUR WE WILL STOP AT A TAP ROOM WHERE GUESTS CAN SAMPLE BEER FROM ACROSS THE COUNTRY AT A  SLIGHT DISCOUNT.  THIS STOP IS APPROXIMATELY 30 MINUTES IN LENGTH AND THEN WE HEAD BACK TO THE SHOP.  GUESTS ARE RESPONSIBLE FOR THEIR OWN BEER TABS.  Minors are welcome to join their parents on the patio and have a soda and snack! E-bikes are available.
